notes.communication: Answering Agent produces an answer; Evaluator Agent returns PASS/REVISE + feedback. Max 2 attempts.
notes.lesson_reuse: Lessons are stored in lessons.json and keyword-matched before answering.
notes.stopping: Stop after second attempt even if still REVISE.
notes.validation: A candidate lesson is kept only if validation correct-count does not drop.
notes.limitation: Keyword lesson matching is brittle; a better approach would embed lessons.
